## Kushagra OS 2.0

A full redesign of the desktop-OS portfolio in a macOS-style design language, plus a live GitHub contribution graph.

**Live:** https://kushagra486.github.io

### Highlights

- **macOS-style desktop.** Menu bar with working menus, a dock with cursor-driven magnification, name labels and launch bounce, a new Launchpad app grid, and squircle app icons throughout.
- **Windows.** Traffic lights on the left, focus dimming, cascaded placement, and spring open, close and minimize animations. They still drag, resize and maximize as before.
- **Motion.** Animated gradient wallpapers, a new boot animation, scroll-reveal animations inside About Me, Projects, Certifications and Live Apps, and a scroll progress bar in every window.
- **Spotlight and Notification Center.** ⌘K search with grouped results, and a widgets panel that slides in from the right.
- **Live GitHub contributions widget.** A real contribution calendar with last-year total and current/best streaks. It refreshes on its own and replaces the old broken streak image.
- **Accessibility.** Reduced motion is respected, from the OS setting and from the in-app toggle.

### Also in this release

- 30 projects and 13 live apps, covering every repository on the GitHub account.
- Fixed frosted-glass blur, which never showed up in Chromium browsers before.

### Download

`kushagra-os-v2.0.zip` holds the static build. Serve the folder with any static file server.
